findings: For Android, both paths replace the static-alignment attitude with GNSS velocity heading before constructing the IMU problem.
Default per-epoch pose attitudes are then propagated with IMU delta rotations; source initialization overwrites every epoch attitude with velocity-derived orientation.
Source initialization also switches low-speed interior heading fill to nearest and sets both initial biases to zero.

The approximately 19.6 m/s2 reported bias is an optimized maximum, not a measured initial bias. alignStatic sets acceleration bias to (norm(accel_mean)-g)*unit(accel_mean); that code does not initialize a 2g bias from a near-g stationary vector.
causal_attribution: The completed source-initialization experiment is composite; per-epoch attitude and bias contributions remain unidentified.
existing_isolation_option: --native-epoch-heading-attitude-seeds currently rejects non-Pixel5 phones, so it cannot be silently added to an A325G run. A narrowly reviewed admission extension plus matched executable controls would be needed.
